48734-les-mise-rables-v-4-5-the-idyll-an.creator: Unknown
48734-les-mise-rables-v-4-5-the-idyll-an.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. 1831 and 1832, the two years immediately attached to the revolution of July, contain the most peculiar and striking moments of history; and these two years, amid those that precede and follow them, stand out like mountains. They possess the true revolutionary grandeur, and precipices may be traced in them.

66203-death-dealer-the-shawnee-scourge-o.title: Death Dealer The Shawnee Scourge Or The Wizard Of The Cliffs
66203-death-dealer-the-shawnee-scourge-o.creator: Unknown
66203-death-dealer-the-shawnee-scourge-o.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “Well, Dick, it’s about time that you were tramping,” he muttered to himself, as he cast a look westward and saw that the sun had almost touched the tree-tops. “You’ve got a powerful ways to tramp to-night, and you got to make up for the time you’ve fooled away here. I wish I felt a little bit clearer in my mind, as to what new deviltry the red-skins are planning now. They’re up to something, that’s sure.

arxiv-1908-08535.title: A Class D Power Amplifier for Multi-Frequency Eddy Current Testing Based on Multi-Simultaneous-Frequency Selective Harmonic Elimination Pulse Width Modulation
arxiv-1908-08535.creator: Yang Tao, Christos Ktistis, Yifei Zhao, Wuliang Yin, and Anthony J. Peyton
arxiv-1908-08535.description: Abstract Efficiency and multisimultaneous-frequency (MSF) output capability are two major criteria characterizing the performance of a power amplifier in the application of multifrequency eddy current testing (MECT). Switch-mode power amplifiers are known to have a very high efficiency, yet they have rarely been adopted in the instrumental development of MECT.

arxiv-2105-01675.title: Galaxy Evolution in all Five CANDELS Fields and IllustrisTNG: Morphological, Structural, and the Major Merger Evolution to z ∼ 3 z\sim 3
arxiv-2105-01675.creator: A. Whitney, L. Ferreira, C. J. Conselice, K. Duncan
arxiv-2105-01675.description: Abstract A fundamental feature of galaxies is their structure, yet we are just now understanding the evolution of structural properties in quantitative ways. As such, we explore the quantitative non-parametric structural evolution of 16,778 galaxies up to z ∼ 3 z\sim 3 in all five CANDELS fields, the largest collection of high resolution images of distant galaxies to date.

arxiv-2112-10134.title: An Experimental and Comparative Benchmark Study Examining Resource Utilization in Managed Hadoop Context
arxiv-2112-10134.creator: Uluer Emre Özdil, Serkan Ayvaz
arxiv-2112-10134.description: Abstract Transitioning cloud-based Hadoop from IaaS to PaaS, which are commercially conceptualized as pay-as-you-go or pay-per-use, often reduces the associated system costs. However, managed Hadoop systems do present a black-box behavior to the end-users who cannot be clear on the inner performance dynamics, hence, on the benefits of leveraging them.

arxiv-2204-06188.title: Layer-adapted meshes for weak boundary layers

arxiv-2207-03401.title: Minimum 2 2 - edge strongly biconnected spanning directed subgraph problem Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2207-03401.creator: Raed Jaberi
arxiv-2207-03401.description: Abstract Wu and Grumbach introduced the concept of strongly biconnected directed graphs. A directed graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) is called strongly biconnected if the directed graph G G is strongly connected and the underlying undirected graph of G G is biconnected.

arxiv-2310-13579.title: Numerical approximation of McKean-Vlasov SDEs via stochastic gradient descent
arxiv-2310-13579.creator: Ankush Agarwal aagarw93@uwo.ca, Andrea Amato andrea.amato9@unibo.it, Stefano Pagliarani stefano.pagliarani9@unibo.it, Gonçalo dos Reis G.dosReis@ed.ac.uk
arxiv-2310-13579.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ankush Agarwal aagarw93@uwo.ca, Andrea Amato andrea.amato9@unibo.it, Stefano Pagliarani stefano.pagliarani9@unibo.it, Gonçalo dos Reis G.dosReis@ed.ac.uk. We propose a novel approach to numerically approximate McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equations (MV-SDE) using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) while avoiding the use of interacting particle systems. The SGD technique is deployed to solve a Euclidean minimization problem, obtained by first representing the MV-SDE as a minimization problem over the set of continuous functions of time, and then approximating the domain with a finite-dimensional subspace.

arxiv-2402-08384.title: Selective Learning: Towards Robust Calibration with Dynamic Regularization
arxiv-2402-08384.creator: Zongbo Han, Yifeng Yang, Changqing Zhang, Linjun Zhang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Qinghua Hu
arxiv-2402-08384.description: Abstract Miscalibration in deep learning refers to there is a discrepancy between the predicted confidence and performance. This problem usually arises due to the overfitting problem, which is characterized by learning everything presented in the training set, resulting in overconfident predictions during testing.

arxiv-2407-18227.title: Automated Ensemble Multimodal Machine Learning for Healthcare
arxiv-2407-18227.creator: Fergus Imrie, Stefan Denner, Lucas S. Brunschwig, Klaus Maier-Hein, Mihaela van der Schaar
arxiv-2407-18227.description: Abstract The application of machine learning in medicine and healthcare has led to the creation of numerous diagnostic and prognostic models. However, despite their success, current approaches generally issue predictions using data from a single modality. This stands in stark contrast with clinician decision-making which employs diverse information from multiple sources.

arxiv-2510-19719.title: The magnetic sensitivity of the Ca ii resonance and subordinate lines in the solar atmosphere
arxiv-2510-19719.creator: I. Juanikorena Berasategi, E. Alsina Ballester, T. del Pino Alemán, and J. Trujillo Bueno
arxiv-2510-19719.description: Abstract Aims. The polarization of the Ca ii resonant doublet (H and K lines) and subordinate infrared triplet lines are valuable observables for diagnosing the magnetism of the solar chromosphere. It is thus necessary to understand in detail the physical mechanisms that play a role in producing their Stokes profiles in the presence of magnetic fields. Methods.

arxiv-2512-18628.title: Nested Affine Buildings and Their Group Decompositions.
arxiv-2512-18628.creator: Masaoki Mori
arxiv-2512-18628.description: Abstract In this paper, we construct a higher dimensional generalization of affine buildings and introduce a new structure, which we call Babel buildings . These buildings are non-connected, non-convex metric spaces of non-positive curvature. Despite their non-standard properties, Babel buildings provide an effective framework for studying the structure of groups acting on them.

pmc-10642023.title: Impact of outdoor air pollution on the incidence of pertussis in China: a time-series study
pmc-10642023.creator: Yameng Xu, Yizhe Luo, Na Yue, Danyue Nie, Lele Ai, Changqiang Zhu, Heng Lv, Gang Wang, Dan Hu, Yifan Wu, Jiaojiao Qian, Changzhe Li, Jiahong Wu, Weilong Tan
pmc-10642023.description: BackgroundThe increasing number of pertussis cases worldwide over the past two decades has challenged healthcare workers, and the role of environmental factors and climate change cannot be ignored. The incidence of pertussis has increased dramatically in mainland China since 2015, developing into a serious public health problem.

pmc-10647345.title: Research on Key Technologies for the Static Measurement of Railway Track Smoothness
pmc-10647345.creator: Dabao Lao, Fang Wang, Yongbin Quan, Yukun Liu, Enrico Meli, Jorn Mehnen
pmc-10647345.description: In this study, a static railway track smoothness detection system based on laser reference, which can measure various track smoothness parameters by using multiple sensors, is proposed. Furthermore, in order to improve the measurement accuracy and stability of the system, this paper also conducted three key analyses based on the static track measurement system.

pmc-10737176.title: RELATION OF SPECIFIC DOMAINS OF AGING KNOWLEDGE AND CONTACT TO AGEIST ATTITUDES AMONG DOCTORAL PSYCHOLOGY STUDENTS
pmc-10737176.creator: Grace Caskie, Benjamin Johnson, Eve Root
pmc-10737176.description: Knowledge about aging and intergenerational contact were identified in Levy’s (2018) Positive Education about Aging and Contact Experiences (PEACE) model as the two elements that are key to reducing ageist attitudes. Existing empirical literature examining these relationships has primarily focused on undergraduate, rather than graduate, students and has typically operationalized knowledge about aging as a unidimensional construct (i.e., total score).

pmc-11472456.title: Relationship between peroneus longus tendon graft thickness and anthropometric variables: a radiographic study using ultrasonography
pmc-11472456.creator: Koray Kaya Kilic, Fırat Dogruoz, Omer Faruk Egerci, Murat Yuncu, Aliekber Yapar, Ozkan Kose
pmc-11472456.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the predictive value of anthropometric measurements for two-stranded peroneus longus tendon (PLT) graft thickness using ultrasonographyMaterials and methodsA prospective study was conducted on 204 healthy volunteers (102 males and 102 females) aged 18–40 years. Anthropometric measurements were recorded, including height, weight, body mass index (BMI), fibular length, calf circumference, and ankle circumference.

pmc-11650340.title: First use and evaluation of a novel 6.3 Fr disposable flexible ureteroscope for stone management in duplex kidney: a case report
pmc-11650340.creator: Lin Xiong, Kristine J S Kwan, Xiang Xu, Geng-Geng Wei, Ming-Chi Wang, Zhen-Quan Lu
pmc-11650340.description: BackgroundFlexible ureteroscopy (FURS) is increasingly used as the first-line treatment for urological procedures. Disposable digital (dd-)FURS has been developed to overcome limitations such as durability, degradation, and repair cost of reusable scopes. The diameter of commercially-available models ranges from 7.5–9.9 Fr. This study aimed to report the first clinical application of a novel 6.3 Fr HU30M HugeMed dd-FURS.

pmc-12439371.title: Investigation of musculoskeletal complaints affecting the professional or private life of physicians with different exposure times to lead aprons: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12439371.creator: Christofer Hartung, Hartmut Görtz, Jörg Heckenkamp, Albert Nienhaus
pmc-12439371.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIn medical settings, lead aprons provide protection from ionising radiation but also result in physical strain that may lead to musculoskeletal complaints (MSCs). These complaints may have an impact on the wearer’s professional or private life. Therefore, we aimed to assess the 12-month prevalence of MSCs among physicians with different exposure times to lead aprons, and to determine the proportion of MSC-related restrictions in work or leisure time.

pmc-12606344.title: Structural basis of cyclobutane pyrimidine dimer recognition by UV-DDB in the nucleosome
pmc-12606344.creator: Syota Matsumoto, Yoshimasa Takizawa, Mitsuo Ogasawara, Kana Hashimoto, Lumi Negishi, Wenjie Xu, Haruna Tachibana, Junpei Yamamoto, Shigenori Iwai, Kaoru Sugasawa, Hitoshi Kurumizaka
pmc-12606344.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In mammalian global genomic nucleotide excision repair, UV-DDB plays a central role in recognizing DNA lesions, such as 6-4 photoproducts and cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers, within chromatin. In the present study, we perform cryo-electron microscopy analyses coupled with chromatin-immunoprecipitation to reveal that the cellular UV-DDB binds to UV-damaged DNA lesions in a chromatin unit, the nucleosome, at a position approximately 20 base-pairs from the nucleosomal dyad in human cells.

pmc-13086620.title: A preclinical setup for FLASH radiotherapy beam delivery at isocenter using downstream electron scattering
pmc-13086620.creator: Ikechi Ozoemelam, Rowan Paplanus, Michael Pillainayagam, Donald A. Roberts, Dale W. Litzenberg
pmc-13086620.description: BackgroundPreclinical investigations have shown that ultra‐high dose rate (UHDR) radiotherapy (>40 Gy/s) also known as FLASH‐RT, reduces normal tissue toxicity while preserving tumor control efficacy compared to conventional dose rate treatments. Achieving a UHDR‐capable LINAC requires modifications including modifications to electron gun current and bending magnet configurations, use of dedicated energy control boards and use of lower energy scatter foils.

pmc-13617462.title: Challenges in the detection and assembly of virus integration structures in human genomes
pmc-13617462.creator: Xinyi Deng, Xiaomeng Du, Elizabeth Gensterblum-Miller, Jordan Currie, Behirda Karaj Majchrowski, Penelope Lialios, Apurva Bhangale, Matthew E. Spector, Alan P. Boyle, J. Chad Brenner, Ryan E. Mills
pmc-13617462.description: Oncogenic viral infections are major contributors to cancer development worldwide. Tumor-associated viruses such as human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), Epstein–Barr virus (EBV), and Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCPyV) can promote malignant transformation through diverse mechanisms, including persistent viral gene expression, chronic inflammation, and, in some cases, integration of viral DNA into the host genome.
